blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep learning models have become essential tools in medical imaging, yet training them end-to-end for diverse tasks remains challenging due to limited labeled data and computational constraints. To address this, we introduce Brain2Vec, a foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans pooled from multiple studies. Brain2Vec can serve both as a weight initialization backbone for fine-tuning downstream tasks and as a standalone feature extractor. We evaluated Brain2Vec in three tasks: downstream predictive performance, convergence speed, and embedding quality. Using Brain2Vec's pretrained weights as initialization and fine-tuning on labeled data for a brain age prediction task, results demonstrate improved final accuracy and faster convergence compared to random initialization. Additionally, its frozen embeddings outperform anatomically defined volumetric features on four of five downstream classification tasks and perform competitively with a state-of-the-art foundation model pre-trained on substantially more data. Lastly, we show that Brain2Vec encodes information primarily from a spatially localized and neuroanatomically meaningful set of brain regions, and that manipulating a subset of latent features produces monotonic, region-specific effects on the reconstructed anatomy. Brain2Vec code and trained models are available as an open-source package on https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec. Users can apply Brain2Vec locally by installing the package, or directly through the NiChart cloud platform https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com, where Brain2Vec features can be derived without requiring local installation or specialized infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 深层学习模型已成为医学成像方面必不可少的工具,但由于贴有标签的数据有限和计算限制,因此对模型进行不同任务的端到端培训仍然具有挑战性。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了Brain2Vec(Brain2Vec),这是一个基础模型,在74,425 T1加权磁共振成像(MRI)扫描上预训,通过多种研究集合. 大脑2 Vec既可作为重力初始化主干线,用于微调下游任务,也可作为独立的特性提取器. 我们评价了Brain2Vec的三项任务:下游预测性能、汇合速度和嵌入质量。 利用Brain2Vec预先训练的重量作为脑龄预测任务的标注数据的初始化和微调,结果显示与随机初始化相比,最终精度提高,趋同速度加快. 此外,其冻结嵌入在五个下游分类任务中的四个任务上超过了解剖定义的体积特征,并具有竞争能力,在大量数据方面预先培训了最先进的基础模型。 最后,我们显示,Brain2Vec主要从空间局部和神经解剖有意义的一组大脑区域对信息进行编码,而操纵一组潜伏的特征则对重建的解剖学产生单一的区域特异性效应。 大脑2 在https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec上,Vec代码和训练有素的模型作为开源软件包提供. 用户可通过安装软件包或直接通过NiChart云平台在本地应用Brain2Vec https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com,其中Brain2Vec的特性可以在不需要本地安装或专用基础设施的情况下产生.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Traditional machine learning approaches for deriving imaging biomarkers from structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) typically rely on a predefined feature extraction step, such as segmentation or parcellation of regional anatomy, followed by supervised modeling on the resulting measurements ( Doshi et al., 2016 ; Bashyam et al., 2025 ) . These pipelines have supported a wide range of neuroimaging applications, including brain age estimation and disease prediction Rathore et al. (2017) , but they depend on predefined anatomical segmentations and task-specific model development.
blocks.zh: 从结构磁共振成像(MRI)中生成成像生物标记的传统机器学习方法通常依靠预先确定的特征提取步骤,如区域解剖学的分解或分解,然后对由此产生的测量结果进行监督模型(Doshi等人,2016年;Bashyam等人,2025年)。 这些管道支持了广泛的神经成像应用,包括大脑年龄估计和疾病预测Rathore等人(2017年),但它们依赖于预先定义的解剖分解和任务特定模型的开发.

blocks.en: Deep learning (DL) has made it possible to learn predictive representations directly from images, potentially bypassing hand-engineered feature pipelines. In practice, however, training end-to-end models for specific neuroimaging tasks poses significant challenges. MRI volumes are substantially more computationally demanding than 2D natural images, with 3D volume-based training incurring considerable memory and computational costs ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ) . At the same time, neuroimaging datasets are typically small, labeled datasets are limited, and class distributions are often imbalanced, contrasting sharply with the large-scale labeled datasets available in computer vision, such as ImageNet Deng et al. (2009) with over 14 million images for 2D classification. These constraints hinder the development of robust task-specific deep models and motivate the need for transferable representations learned from large, heterogeneous MRI collections.
blocks.zh: 深层学习(DL)使得直接从图像中学习预测性表述成为可能,有可能绕过手动工程的特征管道. 然而,在实践中,针对特定神经成像任务的培训端到端模型构成重大挑战. 磁共振卷的计算要求大大高于2D自然图像,基于3D卷的训练产生了相当大的内存和计算成本(Chen等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2023年)。 同时,神经成像数据集一般规模较小,标签数据集有限,分类分布常常不平衡,与计算机视觉中现有的大规模标签数据集形成鲜明对比,如ImageNet Deng等人(2009年),2D分类的图像超过1400万. 这些制约因素阻碍了制定强有力的针对具体任务的深入模式,并促使人们需要从大型、多样化的核磁共振收集中吸取可转让的表述。

blocks.en: Self-supervised pre-training offers a practical way to mitigate these limitations by learning transferable image representations from large collections of unlabeled scans ( Huang et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2022 ) . Rather than optimizing directly for a single downstream target, self-supervised models are trained using a generic pretext objective and can then be adapted to classification or regression tasks using substantially smaller labeled datasets. This paradigm is especially appealing in neuroimaging, where large-scale imaging repositories are increasingly available, but task-specific annotations remain expensive, heterogeneous, and often scarce.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的预训为减轻这些限制提供了一种实用的方法,方法是从大量未加标签的扫描器收集中学习可转移的图像表示(Huang等人,2023年;He等人,2022年)。 自我监督的模型不是直接为单个下游目标优化,而是使用通用借口目标进行训练,然后可以适应分类或回归任务,使用显著较小的标签数据集。 这种模式在神经成像方面特别有吸引力,因为大型成像存储器越来越多,但针对具体任务的说明仍然昂贵、多样,而且往往很少。

blocks.en: In this work, we present Brain2Vec, a self-supervised foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted MRI scans pooled from multiple studies within the iSTAGING harmonized dataset Habes et al. (2021) . The training data span a broad range of scanner hardware, acquisition protocols, and clinical populations, allowing the model to learn a high-dimensional representation of neuroanatomy from diverse real-world data. Brain2Vec produces a 768-dimensional embedding for each scan, which can be used in two complementary ways: as initialization for downstream fine-tuning, or as a frozen feature representation for supervised prediction.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了Brain2Vec,一种自我监督的基础模型,在74,425 T1加权核磁共振扫描器上进行预训,该扫描器是从iSTAGING统一数据集Habes等人(2021年)范围内的多个研究集合而成的. 培训数据涉及广泛的扫描仪硬件、获取协议和临床人群,使模型能够从各种真实世界数据中学习神经解剖学的高维表现。 Brain2Vec为每次扫描都产生768维嵌入,可以两种互补的方式使用:作为下游微调的初始化,或者作为监督预测的冷冻特征代表.

blocks.en:
Validation experiments demonstrate that Brain2Vec improves both predictive performance and convergence speed when used for encoder fine-tuning. When evaluated as a feature extractor, Brain2Vec outperformed SPARE-BA, a brain age model trained on regional volumes derived from DLMUSE ( Bashyam et al., 2025 ) anatomical segmentation, across all tasks except a single AD prediction task. It also outperformed NeuroJEPA Huang et al. (2026) , a foundation model pre-trained on 1.55 1.55 M scans ( 683,860 683,860 T1w), on multiple classification and brain age prediction tasks. This result is particularly notable given that Brain2Vec was pre-trained on ≈ 9.2 × \approx 9.2\times less data. This suggests that learning a strong representation of brain structure may not require pretraining at the scale of millions of scans. Unlike natural-image datasets, where visual content varies enormously across scenes, objects, and viewpoints, preprocessed structural brain MRI is
a comparatively low-variance domain: scans are skull-stripped and registered to a common atlas space, so the variability a model must capture is largely confined to inter-individual anatomical differences, including aging and disease related changes, and acquisition effects. Together, these results establish Brain2Vec as an effective self-supervised backbone for structural neuroimaging analysis.

比较低的变异域:扫描是头骨抽取的,并登记在一个共同的地图册空间,因此一个模型必须捕获的变异性很大程度上局限于个人之间的解剖差异,包括老化和疾病相关的变化,以及获取效应. 这些结果共同将Brain2Vec确立为结构神经成像分析的有效自我监督骨干.

blocks.en: This work makes the following contributions: 1. First, we introduce Brain2Vec, a self-supervised 3D masked autoencoder trained on 74,425 T1-weighted MRI scans drawn from multiple studies, with the goal of learning transferable representations of brain structure. 2. Second, we demonstrate that pretrained Brain2Vec weights serve as a stronger initialization for downstream task-specific applications than random initialization. We illustrate this here through brain age prediction, where we observe improvements in both convergence speed and final accuracy. 3. Third, we show that frozen Brain2Vec embeddings support competitive lightweight downstream modeling. They outperform segmentation-based volumetric features on four of five disease and risk-factor classification tasks, performing competitively with NeuroJEPA Huang et al. (2026) , while achieving strong brain age prediction performance. 4. Last, we perform an extensive analysis of Brain2Vec latent embeddings, showing that the model encodes information primarily from a spatially localized and neuroanatomically meaningful set of brain regions. We prove that manipulating a subset of latent features produces monotonic, region-specific effects on the reconstructed anatomy, which is important for the interpretability of disease or aging related effects.
blocks.zh: 这项工作作出了以下贡献: 1. 首先,我们引入Brain2Vec,这是自控的3D蒙面自动编码器,通过从多种研究中抽取的74,425 T1加权磁共振扫描技术培训,目的是学习大脑结构的可转移表示. 2. 第二,我们证明,预先训练的Brain2Vec重量比随机初始化更能促进下游任务特定应用的初始化。 我们在这里通过大脑年龄预测来说明这一点,我们在此观察到在汇合速度和最终准确性两方面都有所改善。 3. 第三,我们显示,冷冻的Brain2Vec嵌入支持竞争性轻量级下游模型。 它们在五种疾病中的四种疾病和风险因素分类任务上超越了基于分化的体积特征,与NeuroJEPA Huang等人(2026年)进行了竞争,同时实现了强大的脑龄预测性能. 4. 最后,我们对Brain2Vec潜伏嵌入物进行了广泛分析,显示模型主要从空间局部和神经元原子有意义的一组大脑区域编码信息。 我们证明,操纵一组潜在特征会对重建的解剖学产生单一的、针对具体区域的影响,这对于解释疾病或老化相关影响十分重要。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Structural neuroimaging has a long tradition of characterizing brain morphology through segmentation-based pipelines, in which anatomically defined regions of interest (ROIs) are delineated and summarized as volumetric, morphometric, or thickness-based features, encompassing measures such as regional volumes, cortical thickness, surface area, and lesion or abnormality loads ( Fischl and Dale, 2000 ; Fischl, 2012 ; Doshi et al., 2016 ; Griffanti et al., 2016 ; Billot et al., 2023 ) . Imaging features are used in downstream pipelines as inputs to conventional machine learning models for tasks such as disease classification, brain age prediction, and biomarker discovery ( Habes et al., 2016 ; Cole and Franke, 2017 ; Rathore et al., 2017 ; Hwang et al., 2022 ) . This paradigm has driven substantial progress in neuroimaging research, enabling the discovery of imaging biomarkers and the development of predictive models across a wide range of conditions, including Alzheimer’s disease, brain aging, and psychiatric disorders. However, its reliance on a-priori anatomical definitions and task-specific model development inherently constrains its generalizability across diverse clinical applications.
blocks.zh: 结构神经成像具有通过分化管道描述大脑形态的悠久传统,在这种管道中,解剖界定的利益区域被划定和概括为体积、morphometery或厚度特征,包括区域体积、皮质厚度、表面积和损伤或异常负载等措施(Fischl和Dale,2000年;Fischl,2012年;Doshi等人,2016年;Griffanti等人,2016年;Billot等人,2023年)。 成像特征用于下游管道,作为常规机器学习模型的投入,用于疾病分类,脑龄预测,生物标志物发现等任务(Habes等人,2016年;Cole和Franke,2017年;Rathore等人,2017年;Hwang等人,2022年). 这一范式推动了神经成像研究的重大进展,使得人们能够发现成像生物标志,并在包括阿尔茨海默氏病、脑老化和精神障碍在内的各种条件下开发预测模型。 然而,它依赖优先解剖定义和具体任务模型开发,这本身就限制了它在各种临床应用中的普遍性。

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning has proven particularly well-suited to settings where labeled data are limited but unlabeled scans are abundant. In computer vision, Vision Transformers (ViTs) showed that images can be modeled effectively as sequences of patches, while masked autoencoders (MAEs) demonstrated that reconstructing heavily masked inputs can yield scalable and transferable visual representations ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 事实证明,自我监督的学习特别适合标签数据有限但无标签扫描丰富的环境。 在计算机视觉中,ViTs(ViTs)显示图像可以作为补丁的序列有效建模,而蒙面的自动编码器(MAEs)则显示重建大量蒙面输入可以产生可伸缩和可转移的视觉表现(Dosovitskiy等人,2020年;He等人,2022年).

blocks.en: In medical imaging, recent work has highlighted the promise of self-supervised pre-training for improving downstream predictive performance and sample efficiency across classification and segmentation tasks ( Huang et al., 2023 ) . Several methods originally developed for computer vision have since been adapted to medical and neuroimaging datasets. Among these, masked autoencoders have demonstrated improvements in medical image classification and segmentation, including in 3D settings where labeled data are particularly costly to obtain ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Specifically, in brain MRI analysis, domain-tailored self-supervised pre-training has been shown to enhance downstream diagnostic models, and recent work has begun exploring large-scale brain-specific foundation models for neuroimaging tasks ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Cox et al., 2024 ; Tak et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在医学成像方面,近期的工作突出了自我监督的预训的前景,以提高下游预测性能和样本效率,跨越分类和分化任务(黄等人,2023年)。 从那时起,最初为计算机视觉开发的几种方法已适应医疗和神经成像数据集。 其中,蒙面自动编码器在医疗图像分类和分解方面有所改进,包括在贴有标签的数据特别昂贵的3D环境中(周等人,2023年;陈等人,2023年)。 具体地说,在脑磁共振分析中,域名特异性的自我监督预训被证明可以增强下游诊断模型,最近的工作已经开始探索神经成像任务的大规模脑特异性基础模型(黄等人,2025年;考克斯等人,2024年;塔克等人,2026年;黄等人,2026年).

blocks.en: 3 Materials and method
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: The pre-training dataset comprised 74,425 T1-weighted MRI scans pooled from multiple studies within the iSTAGING consortium Habes et al. (2021) . While the majority of scans were from cognitively unimpaired subjects, the dataset also included individuals with MCI and dementia, enabling the model to capture disease-related neuroanatomical changes. We expect that including diseased groups in pre-training plays a beneficial role in downstream tasks presented in Section 4 for disease classification. A detailed breakdown of pre-training datasets and sample characteristics is provided in Table 1 . The dataset was stratified by diagnosis and partitioned into 80% training, 10% validation and 10% test set at the participant level, so that all longitudinal scans from a given participant were assigned to the same set.
blocks.zh: 培训前数据集由74 425个T1加权磁共振扫描组成,这些扫描来自iSTAGING财团Habes等人(2021年)内部的多项研究。 虽然大多数扫描来自认知上没有缺陷的主体,但数据集也包括了患有MCI和痴呆症的个人,使得模型能够捕捉与疾病有关的神经解剖变化. 我们期望,将疾病群体纳入培训前培训,在疾病分类第4节提出的下游任务中发挥有益的作用。 表1详细列出了培训前数据集和样本特征。 数据集通过诊断分级,分解为80%的培训,10%的验证和10%的测试在参与者一级设置,这样,来自特定参与者的所有纵向扫描都被分配到同一个数据集.

blocks.en: Table 1: Overview of datasets used for Brain2Vec pre-training, split by training and validation sets.
blocks.zh: 表1:用于Brain2Vec预训的数据集概览,按培训和验证集进行划分.

blocks.en: For brain age prediction, we used 19,671 19,671 cognitively unimpaired baseline scans from the iSTAGING consortium, spanning 13 studies (Supplementary Table 7 ). To ensure a balanced age distribution across splits, scans were stratified into 10-year age bins and partitioned into 60% for training, 30% for validation, and 10% for testing. For out-of-distribution validation, we used the MIRIAD Malone et al. (2013) dataset, comprising baseline T1 MRI scans from 46 mild-to-moderate Alzheimer’s subjects and 23 cognitively normal controls.
blocks.zh: 在脑龄预测方面,我们使用了来自iSTAGING财团的19 671 19 671个无缺陷的认知基线扫描,涵盖13项研究(补充表7 )。 为了保证各部分的均衡年龄分布,扫描分级为10岁组,并分为60%用于培训,30%用于验证,10%用于测试。 为了进行分配外验证,我们使用了MIRIAD Malone等人. (2013年)数据集,包括46个轻度至中度阿尔茨海默症患者的基线T1核磁共振扫描和23个认知正常控制.

blocks.en: For disease classification, we used 21,176 scans from the iSTAGING consortium, spanning 15 studies (Supplementary Tables 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , and 12 ), covering six diagnostic and risk-factor categories: cognitively unimpaired (CU), Alzheimer’s disease (AD), diabetes, elevated BMI, smoking status, and hypertension. To mitigate inter-site variability, data from multiple studies were balanced across disease groups where possible. All classification experiments were evaluated using 5-fold stratified cross-validation. For out-of-distribution validation, we used the IXI Biomedical Image Analysis Group, Imperial College London () dataset which consists of 581 581 cognitively unimpaired subjects. We removed subjects aged ≤ 40 \leq 40 , resulting in a total of n = 363 n=363 , reflecting the clinical scope of the model where neurodegeneration-related structural changes are most relevant.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the Brain2Vec pre-training architecture and downstream applications. (Pre-training) Brain2Vec is a 3D Masked Autoencoder (MAE) pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted MRI scans from the iSTAGING consortium. Input volumes are divided into 8 × 8 × 8 8\times 8\times 8 patches, with 75% randomly masked. A 12-layer Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder processes only the visible patches to generate a 768-dimensional latent representation. Mask tokens are then introduced, and an 8-layer ViT decoder reconstructs the original scan. (Evaluation) The pre-trained encoder serves two complementary roles. First, it provides a robust weight initialization for end-to-end fine-tuning on a downstream task (brain age regression), accelerating convergence and improving accuracy relative to random initialization. Second, its frozen 768-dimensional embeddings serve as fixed features for lightweight downstream models, including a Support Vector Regressor (SVR) for brain age regression and SVMs for five binary classification tasks: CU vs. AD, elevated BMI, diabetes, smoking status, and hypertension. We additionally assess the quality and interpretability of these frozen embeddings via self-attention visualization, correlation with anatomically-defined Regions of Interest (ROIs), and latent-space manipulation, showing that Brain2Vec encodes spatially localized, neuroanatomically meaningful representations.

blocks.en: Brain2Vec is a 3D Masked Autoencoder He et al. (2022) with an assymetric encoder-decoder design (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: Brain2Vec是三维面罩自动编码器 He et al. (2022) 具有不对称编码器-解码器设计(图1).

blocks.en: A preprocessed volume x ∈ ℝ 128 × 128 × 128 x\in\mathbb{R}^{128\times 128\times 128} is split into N = 16 3 = 4096 N=16^{3}=4096 non-overlapping 8 × 8 × 8 8\times 8\times 8 patches { x p } p = 1 N \{x_{p}\}_{p=1}^{N} , each flattened to a 512-dimensional vector and linearly projected to the encoder width d = 768 d=768 . A learnable [CLS] token is prepended to the sequence.

The encoder is a 12-layer ViT Dosovitskiy et al. (2020) with a hidden size of 768, 12 attention heads, and an MLP ratio of 4. A random subset (75%) of patches are masked and the encoder only processes a small subset of visible patches (25%), without incorporating mask tokens Devlin et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 编码器为12层ViT Dosovitskiy et al. (2020),隐藏尺寸为768,12个注意力头,MLP比为4. 一个随机的子集(75%)的补丁被蒙蔽,编码器只处理一个小子集的可见补丁(25%),而没有包含面具符Devlin等人(2019年).

blocks.en: The decoder is an 8-layer ViT with an input dimensionality of d = 512 d=512 and 16 attention heads. The encoder’s outputs are first projected to the required dimensionality and a shared learnable mask token is inserted at every masked position, followed by positional embeddings. The decoder processes the full sequence of tokens and a linear head predicts the 8 × 8 × 8 = 512 8\times 8\times 8=512 voxel values of each patch. In all previous work, the decoder is not used for feature extraction but only during pre-training and discarded afterwards. We proposed an approach on using the decoder for interpretability (Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: The pre-trained Brain2Vec model was evaluated on six downstream tasks including: (i) five classification tasks (CU vs. AD, elevated BMI, diabetes, smoking status and hypertension) and (ii) a brain age prediction task, under two complementary configurations:
blocks.zh: 对预先训练的Brain2Vec模型进行了6项下游任务的评价,其中包括:(一) 5项分类任务(CU vs. AD,升高的BMI,糖尿病,吸烟状态和高血压)和(二) 脑龄预测任务,在两个互补配置下:

blocks.en: • Encoder fine-tuning: The pre-trained encoder weights were used as initialization for a Vision Transformer (ViT) applied to a brain age prediction task. This approach preserves the original ViT architecture, allowing the downstream model to leverage the rich structural representations acquired during pre-training. • Feature extraction: MRI scans were passed through the frozen pre-trained encoder to extract 768-dimensional embeddings (Brain2Vec features), which subsequently served as fixed input representations for lightweight downstream models using Support Vector Machines (SVMs).

blocks.en: We compared fine-tuning from Brain2Vec pretrained weights against training from random initialization, measuring both final accuracy and convergence speed. In the feature extraction setting, we compared downstream predictive performance against SPARE-BA, a model trained using segmentation-based regional volumetric features and using features extracted from NeuroJEPA, a state-of-the-art foundation model, providing a direct assessment of Brain2Vec relative to both traditional and more recent neuroimaging feature pipelines.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Brain2Vec的微调预加载重量与随机初始化的训练,测量最终准确度和汇合速度。 在特征提取设定中,我们对照SPARE-BA对下游预测性能进行了比较。 SPARE-BA是利用分区为基础的区域体积特征以及利用从NeuroJEPA中提取的特征而培训的模型,是一种最先进的基础模型,它直接评估了Brain2Vec相对于传统和较近期的神经成像特征管道的情况。

blocks.en: Brain2Vec encoder weights were used to initialize a ViT-based brain age regression model (ViT-BA). We fine-tuned the model on our brain age prediction dataset explained in Sec. 3.1 . In contrast to Brain2Vec model training stage, where maximizing training data sample size was prioritized, a larger proportion of data was used in this validation experiment to ensure robust evaluation of regression performance on the downstream task. Data were partitioned into 60% for training, 30% for validation, and 10% for testing. All training configurations and hyperparameters were kept consistent with those used during the Brain2Vec model training. Results are reported with and without Brain2Vec initialization, enabling a direct assessment of the contribution of transfer learning to downstream regression performance.

blocks.en: As expected from pre-trained initializations, optimization dynamics were markedly improved, with the Brain2Vec-initialized model bypassing the initial plateau within fewer than 10 epochs compared to approximately 50 epochs for the randomly initialized model (Fig. 3 ). This confirms that self-supervised pre-training provides a superior weight initialization that optimizes training efficiency, accelerating convergence.

blocks.en: We trained a Support Vector Regressor (SVR) on frozen Brain2Vec encoder embeddings to predict brain age. The rationale is that an effectively pretrained encoder that captures neuroanatomically relevant structure should enable a simple non-parametric model to generalize effectively to age prediction from fixed embeddings alone, without any backbone fine-tuning. We used 5-fold cross-validation for data splitting, with hyperparameters tuned via Optuna Akiba et al. (2019) using nested 5-fold cross-validation on the training folds, optimizing for R 2 R^{2} score. Splits were randomly sampled.
blocks.zh: 我们在冷冻的Brain2Vec编码器嵌入器上训练了辅助矢量回流器(SVR),以预测脑龄. 其原理是,一个能捕捉神经元解剖相关结构的有效预导编码器,应当能够使简单的非参数模型能够从固定嵌入物中有效概括到年龄预测,而无需任何骨干微调. 我们用5倍的交叉验证来进行数据分解,高参数通过Optuna Akiba等人(2019年)调制,在训练折叠上使用5倍的嵌套交叉验证,优化R 2 R^{2}分数. 随机抽取了分块。

blocks.en: Our results (Table 3 , Fig. 5 ) demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves performance comparable to fully supervised ViT regressors, despite its simplicity, suggesting that Brain2Vec embeddings capture rich structural information relevant to brain aging. Notably, the SVR model trained on Brain2Vec features outperformed SPARE-BA, a validated and established brain age estimation method trained on volumetric features from anatomical segmentation using a pre-defined atlas Habes et al. (2016) , and performed comparable to SVR models trained on NeuroJEPA embeddings. This suggests that Brain2Vec features encode structural information that is at least as informative as anatomically defined, handcrafted regional volume features. We also evaluated the utility of brain age gap (predicted age − - actual age) to capture disease related or risk-factor effects on multiple disease-specific datasets described in Sec. 3.1 . The brain age gap from Brain2Vec-SVR model showed significant group differences in AD (Cohen’s d = 0.94 0.94 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and elevated BMI (Cohen’s d = 0.43 0.43 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), outperforming ViT-BA model on this measure. Results are reported in supplementary Fig. 8 .

blocks.en: Validations on the external IXI dataset were performed using the same SVR models trained in the cross-validation folds, without any additional training or fine-tuning. This approach was chosen to directly assess the generalization performance of the learned Brain2Vec feature space without any additional model adaptation, consistent with the frozen feature extraction paradigm. The same inference procedure was applied to SPARE-BA models trained on DLMUSE-derived features and NeuroJEPA-SVR trained on NeuroJEPA embeddings, ensuring a fair comparison between approaches under identical conditions. For the IXI inference, we combined predictions from all 5-fold SVR models into an ensemble, as this approach typically yields more robust and stable predictions by averaging out individual model variances. The results of the IXI inference are included in Table 3 and Fig. 5 . The SVR model fitted on Brain2Vec embeddings yielded the best results, confirming that Brain2Vec has learned a generalizable representation of brain morphology that serves as a compact yet informative feature space for efficient downstream tasks.

blocks.en: Despite the encoder being trained without any disease supervision, the learned representations yielded strong classification performance across all disease groups, indicating that Brain2Vec captures clinically meaningful morphological structure beyond its explicit training objective. Compared to SPARE models trained on DLMUSE-derived features, our approach outperformed across all tasks in terms of accuracy, AUC, F1 score, recall and precision, except for AD classification, where DLMUSE retained a clear advantage. Compared to NeuroJEPA, Brain2Vec performed better on diabetes and smoking classification, while NeuroJEPA performed better on AD and elevated BMI classification, with comparable results on hypertension (Table 4 ).

blocks.en: We further assessed generalization through external validation on the MIRIAD dataset Malone et al. (2013) , comprising baseline T1 MRI scans from 46 mild-to-moderate Alzheimer’s subjects and 23 cognitively normal controls. The DLMUSE-based features achieved the best overall performance. Brain2Vec reached an accuracy comparable to NeuroJEPA (0.84 vs. 0.83) with substantially higher recall (0.93 vs. 0.76) but lower precision (0.85 vs. 0.99), while NeuroJEPA achieved a higher AUC (0.97 vs. 0.94). Therefore, these differences in recall and precision largely reflect different operating points under potential domain shift rather than differences in discriminative ability: NeuroJEPA ranked the cases well but predicted AD conservatively at the default threshold, whereas Brain2Vec favored sensitivity. Overall, Brain2Vec generalized reasonably well to this independent cohort, although threshold calibration on new cohorts may be needed for all embedding-based models.

blocks.en: 4.3 Interpretability of Brain2Vec’s Learned Representations
blocks.zh: 4.3 " Brain2Vec " 公司所了解情况的解释性

blocks.en: In medical imaging, there is a growing need for interpretable models, as they enable researchers and clinicians to understand how a model makes predictions and which features are important for each task van Veldhuizen et al. (2025) . We assessed Brain2Vec’s interpretability through three complementary strategies: (i) visualizing self-attention maps to examine which spatial regions the model attends to, (ii) correlating latent embeddings with anatomically-defined regions of interest to identify which brain structures drive specific features, and (iii) manipulating latent embeddings and inspecting their effect on reconstructed anatomy to test whether individual features encode monotonic, region-specific changes.
blocks.zh: 在医学成像中,越来越需要可解释的模型,因为这些模型使研究人员和临床医生能够了解一个模型是如何作出预测的,以及哪些特征对于每个任务van Veldhuizen等人(2025年)都很重要。 我们通过三个互补战略评估了Brain2Vec的可解释性:(一) 直观地绘制自觉地图,以检查模型涉及的哪个空间区域;(二) 将潜伏的嵌入与解剖定义感兴趣的区域联系起来,以确定哪些脑结构驱动特定特征;(三) 操纵潜伏的嵌入并检查其对重建解剖学的影响,以测试单个特征是否编码单一的、针对特定区域的变化。

blocks.en: We visualized what the model considers important by plotting its self-attention maps (Fig. 6 ). The resulting maps show that different attention heads learn distinct spatial patterns rather than attending uniformly across the entire brain, consistent with findings in other models Caron et al. (2021) . As shown in the attention visualizations, different heads consistently emphasize different anatomical regions across the axial, coronal, and sagittal views. Some heads exhibit relatively localized attention around specific brain structures, whereas others capture more distributed patterns across larger portions of the brain. This diversity suggests that the multi-head self-attention mechanism enables Brain2Vec to encode complementary spatial information, with individual heads potentially capturing different anatomical or contextual characteristics of the input MRI. An important exception is the behavior of heads 0 and 9: across views and samples, these heads frequently assign substantial attention to regions outside the brain, particularly along the image boundaries and background (see Section A.6 ). This indicates that they are not primarily encoding meaningful brain anatomy and may instead capture image-level or acquisition-related characteristics.

blocks.en: The latent embeddings of foundation models trained on domain-specific data can be interpreted by quantifying their correlation with anatomically defined regions of interest, particularly those known to be affected by disease. To this end, we computed the Pearson correlation between each individual Brain2Vec latent dimension and each DLMUSE regional volume, together with the mean difference in each latent dimension between CU and AD subjects, in order to identify which dimensions are most strongly associated with which anatomical region. As shown in Fig. 7 , several latent dimensions exhibit strong correlations with specific brain regions, including the ventricles, gray matter, frontal regions, and white matter. Consistent with known neurodegenerative patterns in AD, we observe an inverse relationship between ventricular volume and gray matter, frontal, and white matter volumes.

blocks.en: 4.4 Inference Speed and Scalability
blocks.zh: 4.4 推论速度和可扩展性

blocks.en: Inference efficiency is a critical but often underreported aspect of deep learning evaluation, particularly in medical imaging, where 3D volumetric data introduces substantial computational overhead. For Brain2Vec, which processes full 3D MRI scans to produce subject-level embeddings, efficient inference is especially important given the large and diverse cohorts it targets.
blocks.zh: 推论效率是深入学习评价的一个关键方面,但往往报告不足,特别是在医疗成像方面,3D体积数据引入了大量计算间接费用。 对于Brain2Vec来说,它处理完整的3D磁共振扫描以产生主题层面的嵌入,鉴于它所瞄准的组群庞大而多样,有效的推论尤为重要.

blocks.en:
We compared Brain2Vec’s inference time against DLMUSE, which uses an nnU-Net Isensee et al. (2018) to segment the brain and compute ROI volumes from the full 3D input, and against NeuroJEPA, which uses a similar ViT encoder augmented with a Mixture of Experts (MoE) layer Shazeer et al. (2017) at inference time. Benchmarks were conducted on the IXI dataset ( 581 581 scans) using an A40 GPU, as well as single-subject inference on CPU.
On GPU, Brain2Vec processed the full IXI cohort in 30 30 seconds ( ≈ 0.05 \approx 0.05 seconds per scan), an ≈ 87 × \approx 87\times speedup over DLMUSE and an ≈ 7 × \approx 7\times speedup over NeuroJEPA. On CPU, Brain2Vec remained ≈ 8 × \approx 8\times faster than DLMUSE, whereas NeuroJEPA was faster than Brain2Vec ( 6.98 6.98 vs. 45.73 45.73 seconds). This is likely because NeuroJEPA’s sparse MoE layer activates only a subset of its parameters for each input, which reduces sequential computation on CPU. Brain2Vec’s dense ViT encoder, by contrast, benefits more from GPU parallelism. Overall, Brain2Vec offers substantially lower computational cost in GPU-based, cohort-scale settings while maintaining strong predictive performance (Table 6 ).

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced Brain2Vec, a self-supervised foundation model trained on 74,425 74,425 T1-weighted brain MRI scans. We evaluated Brain2Vec across multiple settings: fine-tuning for brain age prediction, feature extraction for disease classification, external validation on an independent cohort, interpretability analysis, and inference efficiency. We demonstrated that Brain2Vec serves as a versatile dual-purpose framework: (1) accelerating convergence and improving predictive accuracy when fine-tuned as a 3D ViT backbone, and (2) offering a rich, 768-dimensional frozen feature space that is competitive with or superior to both anatomically-derived volumetric features and larger foundation models across a range of disease classification tasks. Beyond predictive performance, we showed that Brain2Vec’s learned representations are anatomically meaningful and interpretable, with generative manipulation of its latent dimensions revealing biologically interpretable, continuous neurodegenerative phenotypes in reconstructed brain space.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了Brain2Vec,一种自我监督的基础模型,在74,425,74,425 T1加权脑磁共振扫描上接受了训练. 我们从多个角度评估了Brain2Vec:对大脑年龄预测进行微调,对疾病分类进行特征提取,对一个独立的群体进行外部验证,可解释性分析和推论效率。 我们证明,Brain2Vec是一个多功能的双重用途框架:(1) 在作为3D维T主干线进行微调时,加速趋同和提高预测准确性;(2) 提供丰富、768维的冷冻特征空间,与解剖学产生的体积特征和涵盖一系列疾病分类任务的更大基础模型具有竞争力或优越性。 除了预测性表现外,我们显示Brain2Vec所学的表达方式在解剖学上是有意义的和可解释的,对其潜在维度的基因操纵揭示了在重建后的大脑空间中可生物解释的、连续的神经变质现象。

blocks.en: Our results reveal a consistent trade-off between anatomical segmentations and self-supervised continuous embeddings. While traditional pipelines like DLMUSE excel at detecting localized structural changes such as volumetric atrophy in Alzheimer’s Disease, they are constrained by fixed anatomical boundaries. Conversely, Brain2Vec representations outperformed DLMUSE on harder classification tasks (e.g., diabetes, smoking, elevated BMI). This suggests that Brain2Vec may be learning representations beyond those captured by standard volumetric features derived from anatomical segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,解剖分解与自我监督的连续嵌入之间有着持续的权衡。 DLMUSE等传统管道在检测本地结构变化(如阿尔茨海默病的体积萎缩)方面非常出色,但它们受到固定解剖边界的限制。 反之,Brain2Vec的表示在更硬的分类任务(如糖尿病,吸烟,提高BMI)上表现优于DLMUSE. 这表明Brain2Vec可能是在从解剖分解中得出的标准体积特征所捕捉到的以外学习表现.

blocks.en: One notable finding of this study is that Brain2Vec-SVR models achieve competitive predictive performance relative to NeuroJEPA, a state-of-the-art foundation model, across several downstream tasks, despite Brain2Vec being pre-trained on ≈ 9.2 × \approx 9.2\times fewer scans ( 74,425 74,425 vs 683,860 683,860 ). We attribute this sample efficiency to the inductive bias of our training objective within the structural MRI domain. At their core, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) like NeuroJEPA, use a context input x x to estimate the embedded state of a target input y y . This process relies on a predictor conditioned on an extra variable z z to account for variability during feature-space prediction. However, in standardized neuroimaging datasets where scans are skull-stripped, atlas-registered, and anatomically aligned, latent representation matching presents a relatively low-variance objective. It is well documented that representation collapse is a concern with JEPA architectures Assran et al. (2023) . In contrast, representation collapse is not a concern with reconstruction-based methods. Generative architectures mask a high percentage of the input and use an encoder to produce latent embeddings z z of the masked input y y and using a decoder, learn to reconstruct the original (unmasked) input x x . This forces the encoder to learn high-fidelity structural priors and inter-regional anatomical dependencies across the entire brain volume. This dense supervisory signal explains both the model’s high sample efficiency and the strong, explicit alignment observed between Brain2Vec latent dimensions and regional brain volumes (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 这项研究的一个显著发现是,Brain2Vec-SVR模型相对于NeuroJEPA这一最先进的基础模型,在几个下游任务中实现了竞争性的预测性能,尽管Brain2Vec在XX9.2 ×\\9.2\时间上接受了预训,扫描次数更少(74,425 74,425 vs 683,860). 我们将这种抽样效率归因于我们的培训目标在结构核磁共振领域的诱导性偏差。 其核心是NeuroJEPA等联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA),使用上下文输入xx来估计目标输入y的嵌入状态. 这个过程依赖于一个以额外的变量z z z为条件的预测器来考虑特征-空间预测过程中的变异性. 但是,在标准化的神经成像数据集中,扫描是头骨抽查、地图册登记和解剖对齐的,潜在代表比对是一个相对低变的目标。 有充分的证据表明,代表性崩溃是JEPA架构Assran等人(2023年)所关切的问题。 与此相反,代表性的崩溃与基于重建的方法无关。 generative architectures 遮掩了很高比例的输入,并使用编码器来生成隐藏输入y y的潜伏嵌入z z,并使用解码器,学习重建原始(未蒙蔽)输入x x . 这迫使编码器在整个大脑体积中学习高纯度的结构前科和区域间解剖学依赖性. 这种密集的监管信号既解释了模型的样本效率高,也说明了Brain2Vec潜在维度与区域脑量之间观察到的强烈、明确的对齐(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: A common critique of deep feature extractors in neuroimaging is their limited interpretability relative to anatomically defined ROI volumes. Through latent manipulation experiments (Section 4.3 ), we provided evidence that Brain2Vec’s latent dimensions can be linked to anatomically meaningful, region-specific effects, offering a step toward addressing this limitation. Progressively shifting latent dimensions along disease-associated vectors produced monotonic, anatomically plausible changes in reconstructed scans, specifically capturing ventricular expansion, and gray and white matter volume decrease. This generative steering provides evidence that the learned latent space encodes coherent, continuous radiological phenotypes rather than uninterpretable noise.
blocks.zh: 对神经成像中深层特征提取器的一个常见批评是,相对于解剖定义的ROI卷,其解释性有限. 通过潜在的操纵实验(第4.3节),我们提供了证据,证明Brain2Vec的潜在维度可以与解剖学上有意义的、针对特定区域的影响联系起来,为解决这一局限性提供了一个步骤。 沿与疾病有关的载体逐渐移动的潜在维度产生单调性,在重整扫描中出现解剖上可信的变化,特别是捕捉通风扩张,灰白物质体积减少。 这种基因导向提供了证据,证明所学的潜在空间编码了连贯、连续的放射性苯基,而不是不可解释的噪音。

blocks.en: Despite being trained on a large and diverse dataset, Brain2Vec has two notable limitations. First, UK Biobank dataset dominates the training data ( ≈ \approx 55%), which may bias learned representations toward its specific acquisition protocol and reduce embedding quality for scans acquired under substantially different conditions. Second, the training cohort is skewed toward older adults (mean age 65.0 65.0 years; fewer than 5 % 5\% of scans from studies with mean age below 45 45 ), which may limit the model’s representational accuracy for younger populations. Users applying Brain2Vec outside its training distribution should take these factors into account.
blocks.zh: Brain2Vec虽然接受了大型和多样化数据集的培训,但有两个显著的局限性. 首先,英国Biobank数据集主导了培训数据(约合55%),这可能偏向于其具体的购置协议,降低在大不相同条件下获取扫描的嵌入质量。 第二,培训群体偏重于老年(平均年龄65.0 65.0岁;平均年龄在45岁以下的研究扫描不到5% ) , 这可能会限制模型在年轻人群中的准确性。 在培训分发之外应用Brain2Vec的用户应考虑到这些因素。

blocks.en: Brain2Vec code and trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec . Embeddings can be extracted locally via the installable package or through the NiChart cloud platform ( https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com ), which requires no local installation or specialized infrastructure.

blocks.zh: A.5 选择用于潜在操纵的Brain2Vec特性

blocks.en: To construct the subset of manipulated features S S used in Section 4.3 , we identified Brain2Vec latent dimensions that are strongly associated with specific DLMUSE ROIs and have a consistent, monotonic effect on those regions under manipulation. For each Brain2Vec dimension, we computed (i) the mean difference between CU and AD subjects and (ii) its Pearson correlation with the best-matching DLMUSE ROI. Based on this ranking, we selected the 22 dimensions with the largest and most consistent effects (supplementary Table 14 ).
blocks.zh: 为了构筑第4.3节中使用的被操纵特性SS的子集,我们确定了与特定的DLMUSE ROI有密切联系的Brain2Vec潜在维度,并对被操纵的区域具有一致的单一效应。 对于每个Brain2Vec维度,我们计算(一) CU和AD科目之间的平均差值,以及(二) 其Pearson与最匹配的DLMUSE ROI的关联. 基于这一排名,我们选择了具有最大和最一致效果的22维(补充表14.

blocks.en: We restricted this latent manipulation analysis to the CU vs. AD task because it shows the largest anatomical differences between groups among the classification tasks we studied. We repeated the same selection procedure for other tasks in our cohort, including elevated BMI, smoking, diabetes, and hypertension, but did not observe features with comparably strong effects. This suggests that the latent directions identified for CU vs. AD reflect a stronger, more anatomically coherent signal than those for tasks with subtler or more heterogeneous structural correlates.
blocks.zh: 我们把这种潜在的操纵分析限制在我们所研究的分类任务中,因为它显示了各组之间最大的解剖差异。 我们重复了我们群体中其他任务的相同选择程序,包括高血压、吸烟、糖尿病和高血压,但没有观察到具有类似强烈效果的特征。 这表明CU vs. AD的潜在方向反映了一个比那些具有更微妙或更多样化的结构关联性的任务更强大、更具解剖一致性的信号。
